endpoints.name: Root
endpoints.description: The API root, listing the available resources and the authenticated account. A discovery and connectivity check.

endpoints.name: Product
endpoints.description: One app by its Appfigures product id, with its store metadata.

endpoints.name: Product Search
endpoints.description: Apps matching a search term across the connected stores, including apps the account does not own. Competitor discovery.

endpoints.name: Product by Store ID
endpoints.description: One app looked up by store and the store's own id. The bridge from an App Store or Play Store identifier to the Appfigures product id everything else needs.

endpoints.name: My Products
endpoints.description: The apps connected to the account, optionally filtered by store. THE STARTING POINT: every report here takes product ids, and these are the ones the account actually owns, as opposed to the whole store catalogue the product endpoints can reach.

endpoints.name: Report Regions
endpoints.description: Sales broken down by region over a date range. The geographic cut of the sales report.

endpoints.name: Report Revenue
endpoints.description: Revenue over a date range, grouped the same ways. Distinct from Report Sales, which counts units: revenue is net of the store's commission and of refunds, so revenue and downloads do not move together.

endpoints.name: Reports Subscriptions
endpoints.description: Subscription figures over a date range -- active subscriptions, new, renewals, cancellations and revenue. The recurring-revenue view, which the one-off sales report cannot express.

endpoints.name: Reports Subscription
endpoints.description: The same subscription figures with an explicit grouping. Identical endpoint to Reports Subscriptions, differing only in which parameters the connector fills in.

endpoints.name: Reports Ads
endpoints.description: Advertising revenue earned from the ad networks connected -- impressions, clicks, fill rate and revenue -- grouped by product, country, date, store or network. The monetisation side that has nothing to do with app sales, and where an ad-funded app's actual income is.

endpoints.name: Reports Ads Details
endpoints.description: The same ad revenue report at a finer grouping. The same endpoint as Reports Ads with a different default grouping.

endpoints.name: Advertiser Analytics
endpoints.description: Advertising SPEND -- what was paid to acquire users, by product, country, date, store or network. The opposite side of Reports Ads: that is money earned from showing ads, this is money spent buying installs, and user acquisition profitability is the gap between them.

endpoints.name: Ratings
endpoints.description: Star ratings over a date range, with the counts at each star level. The rating snapshot rather than the reviews behind it.

endpoints.name: Ratings Details
endpoints.description: The same ratings with an explicit grouping by product, country or date. Same endpoint as Ratings.

endpoints.name: Usages
endpoints.description: App usage figures -- sessions and active users -- grouped by product, country, date or network, over a range. Only populated where a usage SDK is connected, so an empty result here is an integration fact rather than an absence of use.

endpoints.name: All Usages
endpoints.description: The account-wide usage summary.

endpoints.name: Report Sales
endpoints.description: Sales and download figures across the connected app stores, grouped by product, country, date or store, over a date range. THE CENTRAL REPORT: it unifies Apple, Google and the other stores into one shape, which is the whole point of Appfigures -- each store reports differently and this is the normalised view. Note the figures are as the STORES report them, so they arrive with the stores' own delay and are restated when a store restates.

endpoints.name: Ranks
endpoints.description: The store rank history of given products at hourly or daily granularity over a date range. Requires product ids and dates. The historical series; every other rank endpoint here is a snapshot.

endpoints.name: Ranks Snapshot
endpoints.description: The chart standings at one moment, for a country, category and subcategory. Requires the time and the chart coordinates. Who was where at a point in time, including competitors the account does not own.

endpoints.name: Featured
endpoints.description: A summary of the store featuring one or more products received over a date range. Being featured by a store is the single largest driver of a download spike, and this is the only record of it.

endpoints.name: Featured Full
endpoints.description: The full featuring detail for one product over a range -- every placement, where and when. Requires a product id and dates.

endpoints.name: Featured Count
endpoints.description: How many featuring placements products received, without the detail. The cheap size check.

endpoints.name: Featured History
endpoints.description: The featuring history of one product in one featured category. Requires the product id and category id.

endpoints.name: Review
endpoints.description: User reviews, filterable by star rating. The qualitative record behind a rating movement.

endpoints.name: Review Filters Counts
endpoints.description: How many reviews match given filters, without returning them. The cheap way to size a review set before fetching it.

endpoints.name: Events
endpoints.description: The dated events recorded on the account -- releases, campaigns, price changes. The business context behind a movement in the numbers, which no report explains on its own.

endpoints.name: Archive
endpoints.description: The raw report files the stores delivered, by type and period. The unprocessed source behind the normalised reports, and the way to reconcile a figure against what a store actually sent.

endpoints.name: Latest Report Listings
endpoints.description: The most recent report file of each type. The quick check on whether a store's data has arrived.

endpoints.name: Raw Report Data
endpoints.description: The contents of one archived report file by id. The store's own format, unnormalised.

endpoints.name: Users
endpoints.description: One Appfigures user by email address. Administrative.

endpoints.name: Accounts
endpoints.description: The store and network accounts connected to Appfigures -- iTunes Connect, Google Play, ad networks. Their status is what determines whether a report has data at all: a broken connection produces gaps that look like zero sales.

endpoints.name: Account
endpoints.description: One connected external account by id, with its sync status.

endpoints.name: Categories
endpoints.description: The store category taxonomy across the supported stores. Reference data; category ids differ per store, which is why a cross-store category comparison needs this.

endpoints.name: Countries
endpoints.description: The country codes used across reports. Reference data.

endpoints.name: Apple Country
endpoints.description: Apple's own country and storefront codes, which differ from the general list. The decoder for App Store regional figures.

endpoints.name: Languages
endpoints.description: The language codes used in store listings and reviews. Reference data.

endpoints.name: Currencies
endpoints.description: The currencies revenue is reported in. Relevant because store payouts arrive in several, and totals across them need conversion Appfigures does not perform in these endpoints.

endpoints.name: Stores
endpoints.description: The app stores Appfigures supports, with their ids. The decoder for the store column that appears throughout the reports.

endpoints.name: Sdks
endpoints.description: The SDK catalogue Appfigures recognises. Reference data for SDK-based product searches.
